notes.list_status: Certified. The page reads 'The official certified lists of candidates for the City of Waterloo 2026 municipal election can be found below.'
notes.source_note: district_source_url is itself the candidate list; no extra hop needed.
notes.name_format_note: Ward 7's first candidate is published as the single word 'ABDULLAH', with no given name, alongside the campaign email hi@voteforabdullah.ca. Under caps_surname that is a bare surname, the same shape as Brampton's 'Gursimranjit Singh, -'.
notes.incomplete_warning: Only one mayoral candidate (Dorothy McCabe) and one Ward 1 and Ward 7 candidate each had filed as of 2026-08-11.
notes.structure_match: Ward 1-7 councillor tables, matching n_districts=7 in the structure CSV. The page's at-large Regional Councillor table is the excluded race below.
notes.excluded_race: The regional councillor race is collected here but dropped by the build: see notes/excluded-races.csv. Waterloo's regional councillors sit on Regional Council, not on city council.
notes.other: The page also lists a Regional Chair race (Nina Deeb), which is not a Waterloo council seat and is not recorded here.
notes.position: From the page's headings, 'City of Waterloo ward councillor candidates' and 'Region of Waterloo - Regional councillor'. The city writes them in sentence case; they are recorded in title case, as every other municipality's are. The regional race is collected but excluded from the study.
notes.regional_chair: The Regional Chair contest carries only a withdrawn nomination (Nina DEEB) under a notice that nominations filed before the Better Regional Governance Act, 2026 are deemed withdrawn. It is not a Waterloo council office and is not collected.
